## Project format support

`+` means read and write; `~` means one-way or incomplete support.
Hover for limits. Include any referenced media when sharing projects.

| Format | Soundscaper<br>Desktop | REAPER<br>7.86 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Soundscaper (`.sscape`) | + — :: Original media is referenced by default; consolidation bundles it for portability. | / |
| Audacity (`.aup`) | ~ — Import :: Imports the legacy project and its companion media; no AUP export. | / |
| Audacity (`.aup3`) | + — :: Audio-only import/export, with a compatibility report; Soundscaper-only state can be omitted. | / |
| Audacity (`.aup4`) | + — :: Audio-only import/export, with a compatibility report; Soundscaper-only state can be omitted. | / |
| Cool Edit / Audition (`.ses`) | ~ — Import :: Recognized legacy binary layouts only; unsupported state and missing media are reported. No export. | / |
| Audition (`.sesx`) | ~ — Import :: Imports audio tracks, clip placement, trims, simple fades, and static mixer settings. Effects, automation, routing, and other unsupported state are reported; no SESX export. | / |
| Ardour (`.ardour`) | ~ — Import :: Audio playlists, cuts, trims, static mix settings, and explicit fades; locates nearby media or requests a folder. MIDI, plug-ins, automation, routing, and tempo maps are omitted; no export. | / |
| REAPER (`.rpp`) | / | + — :: Text project with referenced media; copy media when moving a project. |
| Hindenburg (`.nhsx`) | ~ — Import :: Audio cuts, trims, static levels, mute and fade lengths; locates companion media or requests a folder. Pan and fade curves are converted; ducking, plug-ins, transcripts, markers and Narrator authoring are omitted. No export. | / |
| Pro Tools (`.ptf`) | ~ — Import :: Supported native PTF audio edits, track names, trims, and stereo lanes; locates the Audio Files folder. Legacy PTS is also supported. Mix settings, fades, MIDI, and plug-ins are omitted; no export. | / |
| Pro Tools (`.ptx`) | ~ — Import :: Supported native PTX audio-edit layouts; locates the Audio Files folder. Missing media and unsupported mix settings, fades, MIDI, and plug-ins are reported; no export. | / |
| SoundCraft (`.scraft`, `.scraftz`) | ~ — Import :: Audio cuts, trims, static mix settings, and explicit fades from sessions or bundled media. MIDI, plug-ins, automation, and routing are omitted; no export. | / |
| FL Studio (`.flp`, ZIP) | / | / |
| Ableton Live (`.als`) | / | / |
| Bitwig (`.bwproject`) | / | / |
| Logic Pro (`.logicx`) | / | / |
| Cubase (`.cpr`) | / | / |

| DAWproject | + — :: Imports and exports media and supported project structure, with an exchange report. | / |
| OMF | + — :: Import and export OMF2 audio. Export embeds mono/stereo 24-bit WAV, with a 256 MiB decoded-PCM limit. | / |
| AAF | + — :: Import and export audio cuts and embedded media; unsupported processing and picture are reported. | / |
| Round-trip with a video editor | ~ — Framescaper copy :: File-menu handoff creates a separate editable Framescaper copy, with a conversion report | ~ — EDL :: Vegas-style cut-list interchange; no full-fidelity NLE round-trip is documented. |
| Blender track export and live sync | + — :: WAV track bundle and one-way edit updates through the bundled Blender 4.2+ add-on | / — External add-on |
| Labels and markers exchange | + | + — :: Region/Marker Manager |
| AES31 ADL | + — Import / export :: AES31-3 audio cuts, source trims, linear fades, and static clip gain with BWF media; unsupported processing, automation, and authoring are reported. | ~ — Import :: AES31 import is documented; no matching ADL export is listed. |

Review omissions in the exchange report. See [project formats](/projects-and-data/project-files/), [Blender sync](https://github.com/LeoWattenberg/Soundscaper/blob/main/docs/development/desktop-blender.md), and [Framescaper handoff](https://github.com/LeoWattenberg/Soundscaper/blob/main/docs/decisions/product-origins.md).
